_about: M3-ENV-09 post-import rules for the Ashcrown temple kit (game/core/import/ashcrown_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). A copy of the Pemakar kind: every glTF slot maps to the kit's own materials folder, and the LOD chain ends at 4,000 m because the temple, the crest and the crater are seen from the whole zone (the preview and the zone push LOD1 out per placement for the big pieces). The kit exports no -col proxies; walk collision is m2-slice's (swap-in note in the M3-ENV-09 task file).
